newsitem.title: USA: Minute Maid recalls punch in seven states.
newsitem.headline: Minute Maid recalls punch in seven states.

text.p: The Minute Maid Co. said Monday it is recalling about 6,500 cases of its Berry Punch 64-ounce cartons because there could be a cleaning product in the drink.
The company said it was making the recall in seven states where the product was shipped -- North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, Tennessee, Georgia, Florida and Alabama.
The company said the affected cases could contain a cleaning material that affects the taste and that could lead to "gastrointestinal distress" in drinkers.
Minute Maid has had two reports of such incidents to date, both of which occurred in North Carolina, said spokesman Dan Schafer. Schafer said the effects included nausea, stomach upset and cramping.
He said the recall involved about 6,500 cases with 12 cartons each.
The company is investigating how the cleaning material got into the drink, Schafer said.

"We think that a valve got stuck when the product was being mixed up and the solution that they use to clean the lining in the filling machine got into the tank that the product is mixed in," Schafer said. "They're investigating, but that's what we think happened."
